title: Hereticon talk: flood myths rooted in real floods

tellings.quote: Was that behind the flood myths from all over the world there have been really there have been real floods that were really big really huge could be described as biblical in scale.

plain: The flood stories told by peoples all over the world may go back to real floods, ones so huge they could be called biblical in scale. A researcher named Randall Carlson says this, recalling a talk at a conference called Hereticon, and he gives it as his own reading without naming a source. If he is right, those myths would be memories of real disasters, not just legends.
